name: agentchatroom
description: Project-aware coordination between independent CardBush agents, with voluntary rooms and message wake.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate independent agents across related projects
interface.longDescription: Discover active project agents, voluntarily join shared rooms and coordinate responsibilities and interfaces. Explicit invitations link projects. Independent agents retain bounded idle wake. Children stay out by default and may join and communicate only with explicit user authorization; their parent still owns execution.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with other agents working on the project

zh.shortDescription: 让同项目和关联项目的独立 Agent 按需沟通
zh.longDescription: 发现正在处理项目的 Agent，主动加入房间并协调分工与接口。通过明确邀请关联其他项目，父 Agent 保持消息通知和有限次数的空闲唤醒。子 Agent 默认不加入聊天室，用户明确授权后可以加入和沟通，任务执行仍由父 Agent 控制。
defaultPrompt: 与正在处理这个项目的其他 Agent 协调当前任务
